summary: Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Ltd filed a Form 6-K with Q2 2026 results, disclosing it closed the acquisition of R H Guernsey and entered into an agreement to acquire CIBC Caribbean, expected to close in H1 2027. The CIBC Caribbean acquisition is described as compelling and expected to double Butterfield's size, strengthening its Caribbean presence. No price, premium, or advisor details are provided in the excerpt. Butterfield also repurchased 0.3 million shares at $16.1 million during the quarter. Watch for regulatory approvals across multiple Caribbean jurisdictions and integration progress as key catalysts.
